# DateField

Date entry in en-AU order (day, month, year) as three short boxes, shown back as "Fri 24 Oct 2026", with range presets such as "Last 7 days" for filters like "…

`SongNodes.DateField` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.DateField label="…" value={…} onChange={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.DateField" label="…" value="{{…}}" on-change="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (DateFieldProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` | Legend ("Released on"). |
| `value` * | `string \| null` | ISO date "2026-10-24" or null when empty. Date-only: no time zone. |
| `onChange` * | `(value: string \| null) => void` | Called with a valid ISO date, or null while incomplete. |
| `help` | `string` | Help, for example "For example, 24 10 2026". |
| `error` | `string` | Error message; mark only the wrong parts with invalidParts. |
| `invalidParts` | `("day" \| "month" \| "year")[]` | Which boxes are wrong. |
| `native` | `boolean` | Use the native date input with the readable date underneath. |
